runs.name: c12f-mx-I
runs.description: C12f pilot matrix I: {'spread': 'scatter', 'cells': 600}, vent rate 40

evals.js: moire.matter.springs.filter(s => s.kind === 'heavy').forEach(s => s.rate = 40); return moire.matter.springs.map(s => s.kind + ' ' + s.rate)
